content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Gynaecologist Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Vacancies reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities are included within these numbers; the official notice gives the break-up. The notice says the fixed pay is based on qualifications and experience. It covers part-time visits twice a week, of 1.5 hours per visit.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Gynaecologist Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 50 years. Retired government or ex-service medical professionals can apply up to 60 years of age. The notice does not give a cut-off date for working out age. Mandatory: MBBS with an MCI/NMC-recognised MD/MS/DNB/DGO in Obstetrics & Gynaecology, and a valid medical registration. As printed in the notice: "with a minimum 55% and Minimum 5 years' clinical experience preferred". Only Indian citizens can apply. The only relaxation is the higher limit of 60 years for retired government or ex-service medical professionals. The notice gives no category-wise relaxation.

content_sections.heading: Key Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Provide medical care and consultation at the Institute's Medical Centre Diagnose and treat students, faculty and staff Take part in community health and outreach programmes Attend emergency cases beyond regular duty hours when required Work with the campus healthcare team Carry out physical examinations and record medical histories Prioritise patients by clinical urgency

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Application fee: not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection process: not specified in the notice. The general instructions mention a "written test/interview", and candidates must bring their original documents to it. No TA/DA is paid for attending the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The post is purely temporary and contractual. It is part-time. The contract runs up to 31 December 2027. It can be extended based on performance and institutional requirements. The appointment gives no right to regularisation or absorption in future. Staff can use campus facilities, including the library, the sports complex and campus events.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Gandhinagar Gynaecologist Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Apply online at the link provided by IIT Gandhinagar. Fill in all details accurately. Give a valid, active email address. All correspondence will be by email. Submit the application before 2.30 pm on 30.10.2026. Bring your original documents to the written test/interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many hours a week does the IIT Gandhinagar Gynaecologist work?
faq.answer: The job involves two visits a week of 1.5 hours each. You may also be asked to attend emergency cases beyond regular duty hours.

faq.question: Q2. Which postgraduate degrees are accepted?
faq.answer: An MCI/NMC-recognised MD, MS, DNB or DGO in Obstetrics & Gynaecology, on top of an MBBS, is accepted.

faq.question: Q3. Is a medical registration required?
faq.answer: Yes. A valid medical registration is part of the required qualification, along with the MBBS and postgraduate degree.

faq.question: Q4. Can a retired government doctor apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Retired government or ex-service medical professionals can apply up to 60 years of age. For everyone else, the limit is 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: The contract initially runs up to 31 December 2027. It can be extended based on performance and the institute's needs, but it does not lead to a permanent post.

faq.question: Q6. Will I get travel allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be provided for attending the selection process.

faq.question: Q7. How will IIT Gandhinagar contact applicants?
faq.answer: All correspondence will be by email, so give an active email address in your online application.

faq.question: Q8. Whom can I contact about the application?
faq.answer: Email [email protected] with questions about the application process.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the selected doctor work?
faq.answer: The work is at the Institute's Medical Centre on the IIT Gandhinagar campus. The Centre serves a campus community of over 3,500 students, faculty and staff.
